newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dowa Mining rises to high for 1997.
newsitem.headline: Dowa Mining rises to high for 1997.

text.p: Shares of Dowa Mining Co Ltd jumped to a high for this calendar year on Friday morning, helped by its strong group earnings released on Thursday, traders said.
The share price briefly hit a high of 466 yen. At 0044 GMT, it stood nine yen higher at 460.
Turnover was 1.045 million shares, making the nonferrous smelter the 11th most heavily traded issue on the Tokyo bourse's first section.
On Thursday, Dowa Mining said its net group profits for 1996/97 were 9.68 billon yen, up 327.9 percent from 2.26 billion yen a year earlier.
Dowa shares attracted investors also because the share price has risen through 395 yen, the exercise price of warrant bonds issued by Dowa last month.
